title: Akantilado: Sound Design
tagline: Two cats chase a golden orb through the jungle. One falls off a cliff. Sound captures the shift from greed to sacrifice.

context.title: Project Info
context.collaboration_desc: Noah Bots from Ghent Conservatory composed the music. I handled everything else—foley, jungle ambience, cat vocalizations, and two final mixes (stereo for cinema, then 5.1 surround). We worked together remotely to balance music against sound design.

showcase.title: Watch With Sound
showcase.desc: Sound does the heavy lifting here. It starts with a playful chase, shifts into a tense cliff crisis, then gets quiet when the choice happens. Listen for those transitions.

overview.title: What This Is
overview.desc: Student animation about two cats fighting over a golden orb. I was the solo sound designer—foley, character voices, jungle ambience, final mix. Part of DAE Sound 3 course—animation students sent weekly updates and I built the sound alongside their progress over about 8 weeks.

emotional.title: Following the Story
emotional.desc: Sound follows the mood shifts. The playful chase energy turns into something tense at the cliff, then quietens down for the decision moment.
emotional.chase_desc: Light footsteps and rustling plants with upbeat energy.
emotional.tension_desc: Wind picks up with low rumbles and echoes from below. Everything gets sparse and tense.
emotional.resolution_desc: One musical hit when the decision happens, soft breathing, then the jungle slowly comes back

jungle.title: Building the Jungle
jungle.desc: Built the jungle from layered library samples - rustling leaves, bird calls, water, wind through the trees.
jungle.layered_desc: Combined leaves, distant birds, and running water to create the jungle atmosphere
jungle.spatial_desc: Panned the sounds and adjusted volumes to follow the camera movement
jungle.organic_desc: Used library samples with minimal processing to keep things natural

character.title: Cat Voices
character.desc: Each cat has its own voice. The orange one sounds more aggressive and intense, while the pink one is lighter and more playful. Their sounds shift from competitive grunts to worried gasps when the fall happens.
character.personalities_desc: Used different pitch and intensity for each cat to give them distinct personalities
character.foley_desc: Layered paw steps for different surfaces - dirt, leaves, branches - with different weights for each cat
character.evolution_desc: The competitive grunts gradually become gasps and worried sounds as the story shifts

foley.title: Foley Sources
foley.desc: All foley sourced from libraries—paw steps, impacts, branch snaps. Layered and synced to animation frames.

environmental.title: Jungle Layers
environmental.desc: Three zones - high canopy birds, mid-level rustling, low water sounds. Adjusted levels based on what's on screen.

emotional.title: Scene Transitions
emotional.desc: Faded jungle sounds down during the cliff moment. Brought them back after the choice. Golden orb has a subtle shimmer throughout.

chase.title: Chase Sequence
chase.desc: Fast paw steps and branches snapping, both cats breathing heavy. The jungle gets louder as they speed up and the orb pulses with a subtle tone throughout.

cliff.title: The Fall
cliff.desc: The wind picks up and one cat screams as they fall. Echo comes back from the canyon below while the other cat just stands there breathing hard. Save them or grab the orb? There's this dead silence for a second before the choice.

love.title: The Decision
love.desc: The pink cat reaches down to help. One musical note hits right then, followed by soft relief sounds as the tension breaks. The jungle ambience slowly fades back in. Choice made.
